about_the_game:
STORY

As you wade through the dark halls of House Haywood, you will find meaning in blood.

Enter Charles Dalton, a forensics analyst who specializes in blood spatter, tasked with using his expert skill set to solve the disappearances of multiple persons in the snowy region of Haywood. In the darkness of a Tudor mansion, you hear the foghorn blow. You are not alone.

GAMEPLAY

Focused on the real-life practices of forensic analysts, we have created mechanics that allow the player to understand and uncover the truth behind the evidence they find. Throughout She's Leaving, you begin to discover that there has always been a target on your back.

Equipped with a taser, the choice is up to you – are you going to run and hide, or stand and fight?

ENVIRONMENT

Through the dimly lit halls of an ancient home to the haze-covered docks of Haywood itself, journey through handcrafted environments to look for evidence that will help you in your journey. Be sure to search every nook and cranny, as there is a story to be told in every corner.

“Murder is seldom senseless, it's targetted.”

— Charles Dalton

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 or AMD Ryzen™ 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
